title: Laser diode self-mixing: Range-finding and sub-micron vibration measurement
summary: Ben Krasnow of Applied Science shows that a plain laser diode can measure sub-micron vibrations from centimeters away using self-mixing interferometry, and can also be used for range-finding.
why: HN points to it as a cool demonstration of cheap precision laser measurement and the origin of hacks based on self-mixing.

quote.text: a pretty cool video where he demonstrates how a single laser diode can be used to measure miniscule vibrations
